name: core-hand-limit-end-turn
description: Rules audit (core): LRR 2 ACTION CARDS - a player with more than 7 action cards (3 under Executive Sanctions) must discard down. The original posted discard buttons and let the turn end / the player pass anyway; now End Turn and Pass are refused until the hand is within the limit (TurnRules.handLimitRefusal: bot turnEnd / passForRound / passingAbilities, turn.action validate; the web greys them with the reason from value.overLimits). Base: pbd1204 undo save 109 (Mentak active, 0 action cards, every strategy card played). Mentak draws 8: Pass is refused (engine and the button itself); after discarding 2 Pass goes through and Bastion's turn starts.
